Is carbon steel better than non-stick?

Absolutely. Carbon steel gets naturally non-stick as it seasons, without any chemical coatings. It also sears better, browns better, and lasts forever — unlike non-stick pans which degrade within a few years.
How do I care for my pan?
Rinse with hot water, scrub with a stiff brush, dry on the stove, and rub with a thin layer of oil. That's it. No soap needed, no dishwasher, no fuss. The more you use it, the better it gets.

Will it work on my induction cooktop?
Yes! Our carbon steel pan is compatible with all cooktops — induction, gas, electric, and even open fire. It's the most versatile piece of cookware you'll ever own.
